answer: Each active identity pays a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. The fee is charged through a pigment debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the mesa totals, and the ridge anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 7 units per epoch, sustaining 262 aliases for 28 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the attacker. The fee repeats 19 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
